{{Quote|A good lockpick is worth a dozen blasters|Bellum|<ref name="Crisis on Cloud City">[[Crisis on Cloud City (adventure book)|''Crisis on Cloud City'']]</ref>}}
A '''laser lockpick''' was a device which allowed its user to bypass the lock on a secure door.

The outlaw [[Helm Iskraker]] was known to have a set of laser lockpicks.
